ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (ScarCruft) RokRAT cloud-service C2 to pCloud/Dropbox/Yandex from non-browser process
ucs.description: Hunts RokRAT/DOGCALL/BLUELIGHT command-and-control and exfiltration, which ScarCruft characteristically tunnels through legitimate cloud-storage REST APIs (pCloud, Dropbox, Yandex Disk, Box) instead of attacker-owned infrastructure. The high-fidelity signal is a non-browser, non-sync-client process reaching those API hosts.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true allow_old_summaries=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Web.Web where (Web.url="*api.pcloud.com*" OR Web.url="*content.dropboxapi.com*" OR Web.url="*api.dropboxapi.com*" OR Web.url="*cloud-api.yandex.net*" OR Web.url="*webdav.yandex*" OR Web.url="*api.box.com*" OR Web.url="*upload.box.com*") AND NOT (Web.app IN ("chrome.exe","firefox.exe","msedge.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","box.exe","boxdrive.exe")) by Web.src Web.dest Web.app Web.url Web.http_user_agent host
| `drop_dm_object_name("Web")`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
| where RemoteUrl has_any ("api.pcloud.com","content.dropboxapi.com","api.dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex","api.box.com","upload.box.com")
// RokRAT runs from / injects into non-browser, non-sync processes — exclude legit cloud clients
| where InitiatingProcessFileName !in~ ("chrome.exe","msedge.exe","firefox.exe","iexplore.exe","brave.exe","opera.exe","dropbox.exe","yandexdisk.exe","box.exe","boxdrive.exe")
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen=min(Timestamp), LastSeen=max(Timestamp), Hits=count(), SampleCmd=any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine) by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessAccountName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessFolderPath, RemoteUrl
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImDnsActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where DnsQuery has_any ("api.pcloud.com","dropboxapi.com","cloud-api.yandex.net","webdav.yandex","api.box.com")
// DNS-level approximation: Sentinel ASIM network tables lack reliable per-process attribution,
// so triage hits against process telemetry to confirm a non-browser initiator (RokRAT)
| summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen=max(TimeGenerated), Hits=count() by SrcHostname, SrcIpAddr, DnsQuery
| order by LastSeen desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT37 RokRAT Cloud-Service C2 via Non-Browser Process
id: 8f1d2c47-6a3e-4d11-9b2a-7c9e0f3a1b22
status: experimental
description: Detects non-browser process contacting cloud-storage REST APIs abused by ScarCruft RokRAT for C2/exfil
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
logsource:
  category: dns_query
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    QueryName|contains:
      - 'api.pcloud.com'
      - 'dropboxapi.com'
      - 'cloud-api.yandex.net'
      - 'webdav.yandex'
      - 'api.box.com'
  filter:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\chrome.exe'
      - '\msedge.exe'
      - '\firefox.exe'
      - '\iexplore.exe'
      - '\dropbox.exe'
      - '\yandexdisk.exe'
  condition: selection and not filter
falsepositives:
  - Custom backup or automation tools using cloud-storage SDKs
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.t1071.001
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:3 (@DestinationHostname:(*api.pcloud.com* OR *dropboxapi.com* OR *cloud-api.yandex.net* OR *webdav.yandex* OR *api.box.com*)) AND -@Image:(*\chrome.exe OR *\Chrome.exe OR *\msedge.exe OR *\firefox.exe OR *\iexplore.exe OR *\dropbox.exe OR *\Dropbox.exe OR *\yandexdisk.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest
| DomainName=/(api\.pcloud\.com|dropboxapi\.com|cloud-api\.yandex\.net|webdav\.yandex|api\.box\.com)/i
| NOT ContextImageFileName=/\\(chrome|msedge|firefox|iexplore|brave|opera|dropbox|yandexdisk|box)\.exe$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())
| sort(count, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: RokRAT — ScarCruft's flagship implant since ~2017, alongside BLUELIGHT (InkySquid) and DOGCALL — is defined by its abuse of pCloud, Dropbox, Yandex and Box cloud APIs as a dead-drop C2/exfil channel, deliberately blending into normal HTTPS to legitimate SaaS. The process-attribution discriminator (a non-browser, non-sync-client binary touching those exact API hosts) is what separates this from APT

ucs.title: [LLM] APT37 (Group123) weaponized HWP/Office document spawning script interpreter (initial access)
ucs.description: Hunts ScarCruft's signature initial-access chain: a Hangul Word Processor (Hwp.exe) or Office document — frequently carrying an embedded EPS/equation-editor exploit — spawning mshta/PowerShell/cmd/regsvr32 to stage RokRAT. Anchored on Hwp.exe because targeting of Korean HWP users is near-unique to this Korea-focused DPRK actor.
ucs.splunk:
| tstats summariesonly=true allow_old_summaries=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.parent_process_name IN ("hwp.exe","Hwp.exe","Hword.exe","gbb.exe","eqnedt32.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe")) AND (Processes.process_name IN ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe")) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process
| `drop_dm_object_name("Processes")`
| convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
| sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(14d)
// Hwp.exe = Hangul Word Processor; EQNEDT32/gbb = equation/EPS exploit hosts ScarCruft abuses
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("hwp.exe","Hword.exe","gbb.exe","EQNEDT32.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, ParentImage=InitiatingProcessFolderPath, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ChildImage=FolderPath, ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(14d)
| where ParentProcessName has_any ("hwp.exe","Hword.exe","gbb.exe","EQNEDT32.exe","winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe")
| where TargetProcessName has_any ("mshta.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","cmd.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","rundll32.exe","certutil.exe","curl.exe")
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: APT37 Weaponized HWP/Office Document Spawning Script Interpreter
id: 3b7c9e21-4f55-49a8-b0d3-2e1a6c8f4d10
status: experimental
description: Detects Hangul Word Processor or Office app spawning mshta/PowerShell/cmd, ScarCruft's RokRAT initial-access chain
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0067/
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\Hwp.exe'
      - '\Hword.exe'
      - '\gbb.exe'
      - '\EQNEDT32.exe'
      - '\WINWORD.EXE'
      - '\EXCEL.EXE'
      - '\POWERPNT.EXE'
    Image|endswith:
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\rundll32.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate document macros invoking scripting in some enterprises
level: high
tags:
  - attack.execution
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1203
  - attack.t1566.001
  - attack.t1218.005
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\Hwp.exe OR *\hwp.exe OR *\Hword.exe OR *\gbb.exe OR *\EQNEDT32.exe OR *\eqnedt32.exe OR *\WINWORD.EXE OR *\winword.exe OR *\EXCEL.EXE OR *\excel.exe OR *\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\powerpnt.exe) @Image:(*\mshta.exe OR *\MSHTA.EXE OR *\powershell.exe OR *\PowerShell.exe OR *\cmd.exe OR *\CMD.EXE OR *\wscript.exe OR *\cscript.exe OR *\regsvr32.exe OR *\rundll32.exe OR *\certutil.exe)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName=/(hwp|hword|gbb|eqnedt32|winword|excel|powerpnt)\.exe$/i
| ImageFileName=/\\(mshta|powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|regsvr32|rundll32|certutil|curl)\.exe$/i
| table([_time, aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData])
| sort(_time, order=desc)
